messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed on /v1/generate across eu-west-1 and us-central-1. error_rate=12% (2m), p95_latency=3.2s, queue_depth=~1800. Paging @oncall_james. Incident ID INC-6123

oncall_james: I'm on it — acknowledging the page. any immediate customer impact reported?

sre_anya: yep, seeing head-of-line blocking in the batcher/scheduler. big backlog on batcher shards pinned to GPU-5; a few batches stuck at tokenization step, causing requests to hit gateway timeout (10s) -> 502/504 and 500 from runtime when KV prefetch fails.

runtime_paul: quick snapshot from the runtime metrics: 
```
batcher.queue.size=1823
batcher.active_workers=32
kv_prefetch_errors=274
gpu5.mem=98%
gpu5.util=99%
ingress.requests_per_min=11k
```
Looks like kv-prefetch + GPU memory pressure.

pgs_maria: CS: multiple enterprise customers reporting timeouts and some 500s. flagging AcmeCorp, Finlytics, HealthAI as high priority. I'm drafting a short customer message.

oncall_james: can we route traffic away from the saturated scheduler? fallback to smaller model or to dedicated pools? Need quick mitigation and rollback plan.

sre_anya: proposing immediate mitigations: (1) enable overflow-route to dedicated-pool-b at 50% for new sessions, (2) throttle non-committed tenants at 30rps, (3) enable preemptive-eviction on low-priority queues, (4) restart the stuck batcher daemon on GPU5.

deploy-bot: routing-policy update request received: overflow-route=dedicated-pool-b, split=50%. ingress-throttle=30rps(non-committed). change id: chg-889. Applying now.

runtime_paul: executing restart on batcher-gpu5: `kubectl rollout restart ds/batcher-gpu5` — restarting pods now. Also initiating KV cache trimmed for large prefixes.

oncall_james: doing a coordinated step: I will keep overflow-route in place for 10m and monitor. @sre_anya please kick any additional drains.

sre_anya: preemptive-eviction enabled for low-priority queues. kicked KV flush for prefixes >1MB. adding temporary lower batch_size for affected shards.

support_liz: CS update sent to impacted customers: "We're mitigating an elevated error rate affecting inference. Engineers are routing traffic to alternate capacity and throttling new non-committed workloads to reduce errors. We'll update in 15 minutes."

pgs_maria: full impacted list: AcmeCorp (prod), Finlytics (prod), HealthAI (staging->prod spike). PS: Escalated to account teams.

runtime_paul: after restart and overflow route: batcher.queue.size -> 420, kv_prefetch_errors trending down. p95 latency -> 1.8s. still seeing intermittent 502s from gateway timeouts while backlog drains.

oncall_james: good progress. can we temporarily increase batcher workers on dedicated-pool-b to speed drain?

sre_anya: scaling dedicated-pool-b +10 workers now to increase parallel drains. Also lowering per-batch max_tokens to reduce execution time on long tails.

deploy-bot: scaled batcher pool dedicated-pool-b replicas by +10 (32 -> 42). change id: chg-890.

runtime_paul: queue now ~80, error_rate=1.1%, p95=1.2s. recommending to keep throttles and overflow route for 30m and then re-evaluate.

oncall_james: agreed. leave overflow-route and throttles in place. create incident ticket and assign owners for follow-ups.

sre_anya: creating follow-up tasks in INC-6123: 1) investigate root cause of kv-prefetch spike and potential memory leak on GPU5 shard; 2) add earlier scheduler preemptive-eviction threshold to avoid HOL in future; 3) per-customer backpressure knobs; 4) run replay on affected traces to identify problematic prompts.

support_liz: CS will prepare templated vendor/customer follow-up and offer credits if SLA hit.

oncall_james: closing the active page — incident state => mitigated, monitoring. keep this channel open for any regressions. nice coordination y'all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INC-6123 status: mitigated -> monitoring. last_update_ts=6123456920.
